expected.subject: Cancel
expected.body: How do I cancel? And what happens to my old invoices, I need them for SARS.

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. Only the account owner can do this.

Your old invoices:
- Your account stays active until the end of the period you've paid for.
- It then becomes read-only for 90 days so you can export your data.
- After those 90 days, the data is deleted.

To keep copies for SARS, go to Settings > Data > Export. You'll get an email with a ZIP of all your invoices (PDF) and a CSV of clients and payments. We'd suggest doing this before the 90 days are up.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

expected.subject: Recurring invoice didn't send
expected.body: My monthly recurring invoice was created this morning but the client didn't get it.

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

Sorry your client didn't receive this month's invoice. Here's what to check:

1. Auto-send: Recurring invoices are only emailed to the client automatically if "Auto-send" is on for that schedule. If it's off, the invoice is created but not sent.
2. Activity tab: Open the invoice and check its Activity tab. "Delivered" means the client's mail server accepted it, so ask them to check spam and add invoices@kettle.app to their contacts. "Bounced" means the address is wrong or the mailbox is full.
3. Resend: Open the invoice and click Send > Resend, or click "Copy link" to share it directly via WhatsApp or another channel.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.
